1 Audited FR reviewed by AC and app. by BoD at respective meetings held on 28.05.2025. Statutory Auditors have conducted audit of Financial statements.
2 FR prepared as per Ind-AS u/s 133 of Co. Act, 2013 read with Co. (Ind AS) Rules, 2015.
3 Fig. for qtr ended 31.03.2025 and 31.03.2024 represents derived fig. b/w audited fig. in respect of full relevant FY and unaudited published year to date fig. upto 31 Dec. being end of 3rd qtr of relevant FY which were subjected to limited review by statutory auditors.
4 RB vide CC60 of 2019 reg. inc. in catg tariff for post and pre-paid trains. Effect of inc. of License Fee from 18.11.2019 to 22.03.2020 (for postpaid trains) and 27.11.21 to 31.03.2025 (for post and prepaid trains) has not been recognized as the matter is sub-judice.

5 As per T&C of tender, for 4 PPP RN plants, DCOs to be reimbursed GST on sales (net of ITC) availed by them. As per inf. made available by DCOs, Rs. 388.46 lac accounted during year ended 31.03.2025 & Rs.364.83 lac for FY23-24. DCOs represented against claim for ITC. Being examined by Mgt.
6 NAA issued notice dt 25.02.22 for profiteering of Rs.5041.44 lac under CGST Act for not passing benefit of tax reduction to consumers. CCI empowered to adjudicate the matter. However, no communication received from CCI in this matter till date.

7 Certain Licensees invoked arbitration for compensation of diff. rates of regular & combo meal under CC issued by IR and claimed price of welcome drink from 2014 till date. Arbitrator awarded Rs.7471.65 Lac (approx.) in 13 petitions from Jan 2015 to Mar 2020. On record claimant never claimed said amount while submitting invoices for services rendered. There will not be any liability of IRCTC as consequence of award and no need to make provision.

Co. filed objection & Hon’ble HC, Delhi directed Co. to deposit amt. to stay execution of Arbitral Award. Deposited a BG to tune of Rs.8471.65 Lac to stay execution of said award. Hon’ble HC, Delhi set aside & quashed the award of Rs.4200 Lakhs against IRCTC while upholding the smaller claim of Rs.3200 lakhs. The Ld. Divisional Bench by way of judgment dated 10.02.2025 has restored the Arbitral award qua Claimant's claim towards second regular meal & welcome drinks. IRCTC filed SLP against the judgement before Hon'ble Supreme Court.

8 (a) For FY24-25, Exceptional items represent Rs.220.72 lakhs towards reversal of RU, Stabling and other charges waived off on GC train by KTDC for FY 23 & 24, (ii) Rs.3988.09 lac towards net impact of 1 time reconciliation of Legacy balances & (iii) Rs.579.92 Lac being excess provisions written back for PY relating to various expenses.

(b) For FY23-24, net expense on account of Exceptional items amounting to Rs.5853.03 Lac includes (i) Rs.5126.20 Lac being provision made towards revised fixed, variable and Custody charges for 2 Tejas trains w.e.f. 13.08.2021 to 31.03.2023 in line with letter received from MoR even though Co. has made representation to RB for waiver of amount, (ii) Rs.1451.24 Lac being provision made towards diff. amount of profit sharing @25% (40%-15%) up to 31.03.2023 on profits of RN plants operated on PPP model, Co. has made representation to RB for sharing of profit at uniform ratio of 15:85 for all RN plants till FY2022-23. RB has advised for sharing of profit in 40:60 for PPP plants and (iii) Rs.724.41 Lac being excess prov. written back for PY relating to expenses.

9 BoD recommended final dividend of Rs.1 /- for FY24-25 subject to app. of shareholders at AGM & Co. has paid 2 Int. Div. agg. Rs.7.00 per share thereby making total dividend for FY24-25 to Rs. 8 per share.
10 Consolidated results for qtr & year ended 31.03.2025 and for 31.03.2024 are based on management certified financial statements of IRCTC Payments Ltd. Fig. for qtr ended 31.03.2024 are actual unaudited fig. for period from 10.02.2024 to 31.03.2024.
11 Fig. for PY/periods regrouped/reclassified/restated, wherever considered necessary.
